comparisonArm: CONTROL: nothing delivered | NOTIFY: the Hub runs the graded cases and delivers ONLY the counts (attempted/passed/failed) - no case, input, expected or actual value | AUTODIAG_ARM: the Hub runs the graded cases and delivers the full result (counts plus up to 6 failing cases, expected vs actual)
label: REPAIR WITH SUPPLIED TEST RESULTS - the diagnostic runs the graded cases; not held-out generalization

config.order: arm order for task index ti in replicate r is the arm list rotated by (ti + r - 1) mod 3
config.armDifference: ONLY the diagnostic spec attached to the start request (none / counts only / full result). Seed files, guidance, model, sampling, worker and acceptance are identical in every arm.
